title: Pre-26.1 Mob Sounds
description: Replaces the modern baby and adult mob sounds with the classic Pre-26.1 mob sounds
body:
### ◆ Pre-26.1 Mob Sounds
- - -
Not a fan of the modern baby and adult mob sound variants? Miss the higher pitched chirps, oinks, and barks from previous versions? Pre-26.1 Mob Sounds subsititutes the modern baby and adult mob sounds with the classic and widely recognizable mob sounds.
- - -
Includes:
- Classic higher pitched baby mob sounds for Chicks, Baby Cows, Baby Pigs, Kittens, and Puppies
- Classic adult mob sounds for Chickens, Cows, Pigs, Cats, and Wolves
- - -
